method: unittest with real temporary files, a17-byte PART_BYTES override, and isolated subprocess execution of the copied reassembler
scenarios: 53-byte roundtrip into17/17/17/2-byte parts with exact per-part and whole SHA-256
exact boundary produces no empty part
wrong whole hash rejected even with valid individual parts
output created during publication preserved by no-overwrite link
fix_verified: Splitter initial read is bounded by PART_BYTES, allowing a boundary below8MiB without a negative read size. Production1900MiB boundary had not been affected.
limitations: This run validates packaging behavior with small fixtures; root owns splitting and reassembling the full8GB release artifact.
Tests ran on Linux. Windows/NTFS and macOS execution were not exercised.
The reassembler publishes with a same-directory hard link. The output filesystem must support hard links.
Packaging tests do not establish firmware boot, installation success or visual quality.
